module: Neverwinter Nights - Pirates of the Sword Coast

items.Name: Bloodsailor Crossbow
items.Description: You took this crossbow from the corpse of a nefarious Bloodsailor gang leader while in Neverwinter.

items.Name: Bloodsailor Mace
items.Description: You took this mace from the corpse of a nefarious Bloodsailor gang leader while in Neverwinter.
PropertiesDecoded: Human Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1d8 Damage

items.Name: Bloodsailor Morningstar
items.Description: This morningstar once belonged to a member of the nefarious Bloodsailor gang in Neverwinter.

items.Name: NPC: Bloodsailor Robe
items.Description: As leader of Neverwinter's Bloodsailor gang, Vengaul Bloodsail was the one to choose their colors. Blue for the sea and red for blood on the water. The gold was for filthy lucre, ne'er to be forgotten.

items.Name: Bloodsailor Shield
items.Description: You took this shield from the corpse of a nefarious Bloodsailor gang leader while in Neverwinter.

items.Name: Bloodsailor Blade
items.Description: You took this short sword from the corpse of a nefarious Bloodsailor gang leader while in Neverwinter.

items.Name: Blackriver Bastard Sword
items.Description: You took this bastard sword from the corpse of a nefarious Blackriver Bandit leader while in Neverwinter.

items.Name: Blackriver Dagger
items.Description: You took this dagger from the corpse of a nefarious Blackriver Bandit leader while in Neverwinter.

items.Name: Blackriver Crossbow
items.Description: This crossbow once belonged to a nefarious Blackriver Bandit leader in Neverwinter.

items.Name: Blackriver Mace
items.Description: You took this mace from the corpse of a nefarious Blackriver Bandit leader while in Neverwinter.
PropertiesDecoded: Chaotic Good Attack Bonus vs. Specific Alignment +2

items.Name: Blackriver Shield
items.Description: You took this shield from the corpse of a nefarious Blackriver Bandit leader while in Neverwinter.

items.Name: Blackriver Axe
items.Description: You took this axe from the corpse of a nefarious Blackriver Bandit leader while in Neverwinter.

items.Name: Rahman Madani's Spellbook
items.Description: According to the ornate inscription engraved on the cover in multiple languages, this spellbook belongs to a certain Rahman Madani, Esteemed Magi of the Fourth Circle of the Shifting Sands. The internal contents of the book are unintelligible to you, however, written in some unk…

items.Name: Rahman's Cabin Key
items.Description: This simple key is to Rahman Madani's quarters aboard the Midnight Rose.

items.Name: Tattoo of a Rope & Anchor
items.Description: This is the 'Rope & Anchor' tattoo you got as a memento of your time in Neverwinter. According to your crewmate, Nisar, tattoos are sometimes a source of mystical powers...

items.Name: Tattoo of an Eye & Tears
items.Description: This is the 'Eye & Tears' tattoo you got as a memento of your time in Neverwinter. According to your crewmate, Nisar, tattoos are sometimes a source of mystical powers...

items.Name: Tattoo of a Gnaked Gnome
items.Description: This is the 'Gnaked Gnome' tattoo you got as a memento of your time in Neverwinter. According to your crewmate, Nisar, tattoos are sometimes a source of mystical powers...

items.Name: Tattoo of a Heart & Arrow
items.Description: This is the 'Heart & Arrow' tattoo you got as a memento of your time in Neverwinter. According to your crewmate, Nisar, tattoos are sometimes a source of mystical powers...

items.Name: Crude Arrow
items.Description: This batch of crude arrows is made of brittle wood and has been crudely fletched with seagull feathers.

items.Name: Superior Crude Arrow
items.Description: This crude arrow is made of brittle wood and has been crudely fletched with seagull feathers.

items.Name: Crude Bow
items.Description: This crude shortbow has been fashioned from catgut and driftwood. While hardly supple, it still has enough spring to launch an arrow.

items.Name: Superior Crude Bow
items.Description: This crude shortbow has been fashioned from catgut and driftwood. While hardly supple, it still has enough spring to launch an arrow.

items.Name: Empty Bucket
items.Description: Rust mars the surface of this metal bucket but has not yet corroded through. It still appears to be watertight.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Bucket of Water
items.Description: Water sloshes back and forth in this rusty metal bucket.

items.Name: Crushed Stone Bullet
items.Description: This jagged piece of rock is ill-balanced for a sling bullet but it will still serve to take down your prey from afar.

items.Name: Superior Crushed Stone Bullet
items.Description: This jagged piece of rock is ill-balanced for a sling bullet but it will still serve to take down your prey from afar.

items.Name: Catgut
items.Description: This catgut string makes for a strong line. You wonder if there's anything you can use it for.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Cooked Meat
items.Description: This meat has been cooked and cured and is ready to eat.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Edgrimm's Head
items.Description: This is the ill-shaven head of the marooned dwarven inventor, Edgrimm the Mad. Given the savagery of your situation, it seems appropriate to keep a grisly trophy of your accomplishments here.

items.Name: Seagull Feather
items.Description: You stare at the ragged seagull's feather, deep in thought. You wonder what you could fashion out of it.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Fire-Hardened Spear
items.Description: The tip of this crude wooden spear has been hardened to a charred point.

items.Name: Superior Fire-Hardened Spear
items.Description: The tip of this crude wooden spear has been hardened to a charred point.

items.Name: Small Shard of Flint
items.Description: You recognize this small black stone as a shard of flint. Provided you can find some tinder and a proper firepit, this should make starting a fire a breeze.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 80% of Weight

items.Name: Ichor
items.Description: This glob of smelly ichor sticks to your fingers as you handle it. You wonder if it has any particular use.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Leather Hide
items.Description: This uncured animal hide is still soft and wet. You wonder if there's something you could fashion out of it.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Maul
items.Description: A stone has been tied to this piece of driftwood with strips of leather, creating a crude maul.

items.Name: Superior Maul
items.Description: A stone has been tied to this piece of driftwood with strips of leather, creating a crude maul.

items.Name: R.A.F.T. Plans
items.Description: These plans, drafted by Edgrimm the Mad, outline how to construct a Reversible Alternative Flotation Thingy, or R.A.F.T. The primary construction material appears to be planks of wood.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Raw Meat
items.Description: Blood still trickles from this raw shank of meat. You could eat it like this but it would be safest to cook it first.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Ruined Uniform of the Midnight Rose
items.Description: The tattered, salt-stiffened remnants of your sailor's uniform chafe and rub. You're still surprised you survived the capture of the Midnight Rose at all.

items.Name: Sacred Wood
items.Description: This weathered planking has been torn from the remains of an old shipwreck. The troglodytes on this island consider the wood to be sacred and use it to feed their mighty bonfires.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Crude Sling
items.Description: Fashioned from uncured hide, this ragged sling is nevertheless a useful means of striking at your opponents from afar.

items.Name: Superior Crude Sling
items.Description: Fashioned from uncured hide, this ragged sling is nevertheless a useful means of striking your opponents from afar.

items.Name: Sturdy Stick
items.Description: This weathered piece of driftwood should make an adequate club. It's dry enough to serve as firewood, as well. You wonder if there's anything else you could use it for.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Long Stick
items.Description: This slender piece of driftwood should make an adequate quarterstaff. It's dry enough to serve as firewood, as well. You wonder if there's anything else you could use it for.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Stone
items.Description: You wonder if this simple stone might prove useful.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Tinder
items.Description: This is a thin piece of dry, fibrous bark torn from one of the island's many palm trees. It would make an excellent tinder, provided you could find a proper firepit and a means of lighting it.

items.Name: Makeshift Torch
items.Description: The ichor atop this stick burns bright and true. Hopefully it will be enough to keep the island's wildlife at bay.

items.Name: Double-Ended Torch
items.Description: The ichor at either end of this long stick burns bright and true. Hopefully it will be enough to keep the island's wildlife at bay.

items.Name: Key to your Belongings!
items.Description: King Utnal and his troglodyte subjects were apparently able to salvage your belongings from when Lady Tasina threw you overboard. They await you within a locked chest behind the throne. This key allows you to reclaim the items you'd thought long since lost...

items.Name: Ancient Astrolabe
items.Description: This must be the family heirloom that the Lighthouse Gnome, Vantabular Garsp, was searching for. Lichens grow on the mottled brass and one of the arcs has been bent out of shape. You doubt you'd have any reason to keep it for yourself.

items.Name: NPC: Executioner's Garb
items.Description: The duties of an executioner invite all manner of soils and stains. Blood, vomit, spittle, and rotten fruit must all be endured and then wiped clean at the end of the day. Sturdy, non-absorbent leathers are preferred and full coverage from head to toe is a must.

items.Name: NPC: Fanny's Dress
items.Description: Though one must feel pity for any woman forced to grow up with Blackbeard as a last name, Fanny appears to have survived well enough and now revels in her father's position as Governor of Spindrift Town. Swapping out the pirate blacks for naval blues, this voluminous dress shows…

items.Name: NPC: Fanny's Sisters' Dress
items.Description: Like many evil items, these robes are fashioned in great numbers by the Zhentarim and their minions. They are found far and wide across the Realms, and the more hands they touch, the more influence the Zhents enjoy.

items.Name: Wildflower
items.Description: Pegleg Paulson tells you that this wildflower was always one of Sweetie Marie's favorites. It grows on a low-lying bush out by the lighthouse. You never would have found it without the help of his map.

items.Name: I.O.U. - Falstaff
items.Description:
You examine the small sheet of well-worn vellum. The handwriting is thick and black:

"If ye be stout o' heart and firm o' will, ye can redeem this here deed with the likes o' Falstaff the Tattooist for whate'er he has in mind..."

It is stamped at the bottom with a skull and cr…

items.Name: Nisar's Uniform
items.Description: Nisar couldn't bear to remove the Midnight Rose's insignia from the sleeve of this uniform but he's put a lot of effort into disguising its origins while laying low in Spindrift. It seems better suited now to the dangerous times that are no doubt still ahead.

items.Name: Nisar's Battleaxe
items.Description: You find it hard to remember, let alone imagine your crewmate Nisar without his trusty battleaxe. He's quite fearsome with it in battle and you pity anyone who finds their flesh at its cutting edge.

items.Name: Scepter of Storms
items.Description: This scepter plays an occasional ceremonial role within the Umberlant temple on Spindrift Island. The Sisters use it to bless newly wedded couples and to perform burials at sea. Both are common enough occurences that its absence will not go unnoticed for very long.
PropertiesDecoded: Evil Attack Bonus vs. Alignment Group +3

items.Name: Pete's Ring
items.Description: This is the ring Rascally Pete gave to Sir Francis for safekeeping before surreptitiously stealing it back and ensnaring Sir Francis in a wrongful debt of honor.

items.Name: Tattoo of a Copper Dragon
items.Description: This is the 'Copper Dragon' tattoo you got as a memento of your time in Spindrift. Many believe tattoos to be a source of mystical power.
PropertiesDecoded: Dragon Breath, Slow Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Tattoo of a Flaming Skull
items.Description: This is the 'Flaming Skull' tattoo you got as a memento of your time in Spindrift. Many believe tattoos to be a source of mystical power.

items.Name: Tattoo of a Skull & Crossbones
items.Description: This is the 'Skull & Crossbones' tattoo you got as a memento of your time in Spindrift. Many believe tattoos to be a source of mystical power.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Burst (10) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Tattoo of Umberlee's Waves
items.Description: This is the 'Umberlee's Waves' tattoo you got as a memento of your time in Spindrift. Many believe tattoos to be a source of mystical power.

items.Name: Umberlant Robe
items.Description: You acquired this robe from Pegleg Paulson in the hopes that it might help you infiltrate the Umberlant Temple in Spindrift. He let it out a bit at the sides and there are some unseemly sweatstains in the armpits but, other than that, it seems wearable enough.

items.Name: NPC: Vantabular's Garb
items.Description: Like many evil items, these robes are fashioned in great numbers by the Zhentarim and their minions. They are found far and wide across the Realms, and the more hands they touch, the more influence the Zhents enjoy.

items.Name: NPC: Whipped Willigan - no garb, no boots
items.Description: <no desc>

items.Name: NPC: Whipped Willigan - no garb, with boots
items.Description: <no desc>

items.Name: NPC: Whipped Willigan - with garb, no boots
items.Description: <no desc>

items.Name: Whipped Willigan's Fine Leather Boots
items.Description: Whipped Willigan's fine leather boots are a little less fine now than they had been in his prime. The leather has cracked with age and mildew is beginning to overtake the cuffs.

items.Name: Whipped Willigan's Trusty Cutlass
items.Description: The blade of Whipped Willigan's trusty cutlass is etched ornately with the image of a fantastical sea monster. It's hard to make out, however, beneath the rust.

items.Name: Whipped Willigan's Pirate Garb
items.Description: Whipped Willigan must have looked quite debonair in his former pirate garb. Unfortunately, moths appear to have made short work of the seat.

items.Name: NPC: Captain Allendry's Uniform
items.Description: This uniform bears the rank and insignia of Ship's Captain.

items.Name: NPC: Umberlee Armor
PropertiesDecoded: Slashing AC Bonus vs. Damage Type +1

items.Name: Aromatic Oil
items.Description: Fountains of aromatic oils flow through Umberlee's Temple-Under-the-Sea, giving its air-filled upper chambers a saccharine, sickly smell. Despite its ceremonial use, it appears highly flammable, a property that may prove useful.

items.Name: Sigil Activator
items.Description: This arcane device is apparently used to activate the ancient sigils on the Isle of the Dead. Kolmarr has given the crew clear instructions to follow whoever wields it.

items.Name: Old Tom's Trinket
items.Description: Old Tom gave you this small protective bracelet when you first arrived on the Isle of the Dead. It appears to be some sort of lucky charm.

items.Name: Deadman's Boon
items.Description: This piece of rough-edged charcoal has been imbued with negative energy. When thrown, the energy is released, damaging any living creatures with the resulting blast.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Burst (5) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Minor Prism of Negativity
items.Description: Negative Energy has been stored within this glass rod. If you tilt it into the light, you can release the energy as a ray.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Ray (1) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Lesser Prism of Negativity
items.Description: Negative Energy has been stored within this glass rod. If you tilt it into the light, you can release the energy as a ray.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Ray (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Moderate Prism of Negativity
items.Description: Negative Energy has been stored within this glass rod. If you tilt it into the light, you can release the energy as a ray.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Ray (5) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Greater Prism of Negativity
items.Description: Negative Energy has been stored within this glass rod. If you tilt it into the light, you can release the energy as a ray.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Ray (7) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Major Prism of Negativity
items.Description: Negative Energy has been stored within this glass rod. If you tilt it into the light, you can release the energy as a ray.
PropertiesDecoded: Negative Energy Ray (9) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Repair Planking
items.Description: These pre-nailed wooden planks are intended for rapid repairs should the ship's hull be damaged while at sea.

items.Name: Blackriver Plate
items.Description: You took this full plate armor from the corpse of a nefarious Blackriver Bandit leader while in Neverwinter.

items.Name: NPC: Dela's Tunic
items.Description: Though mostly black, this revealing outfit bears the red and blue coloring of the Bloodsailor gang, albeit in muted tones. The original wearer probably wasn't a full-fledged member of Neverwinter's long-standing gang though they likely shared some tacit allegiance.

items.Name: NPC: Edgrimm's Robe
items.Description: Edgrimm's robe is old and dusty but otherwise clean. It is a testament to his mental fortitude that he's retained the discipline to wash it regularly. On the other hand, it may be related to the robe's lingering magic.

items.Name: Small Porcelain Cup
items.Description: A few chips mar the rim of this sturdy cup. It's clearly seen many voyages aboard the Midnight Rose.

items.Name: PotSC Cube Slam
PropertiesDecoded: Paralysis (Gelatinous Cube Poison) On Hit Cast Spell Level 1

items.Name: NPC: Dockhand's Garb
items.Description: Crusted with salt and dirtied with crate-dust, these sturdy workman's clothes have been well-used.

items.Name: Survivor's Journal
items.Description:
Journal Entry - Day 1:
   Storm-driven, the Widow's Promise foundered on unseen shoals during the night, tearing her asunder. I somehow managed to find shore amidst the tumult of the waves and am now stranded on this forsaken isle.
-----
Journal Entry - Day 2:
   Beset by wild b…

items.Name: Golden Apple Room Key
items.Description: This key grants access to the rooms on the upper floor of the Golden Apple Inn. For security reasons, these are typically available only to guests and servants of the Golden Apple.

items.Name: Treasure Map - Wildflowers
items.Description:
Sweetie Marie's favorite wildflower grows near the Lighthouse in the Sandy Spit. Luckily, you have the map!

To follow a treasure map, go to the area it depicts and use it to get your bearings. Follow the map's instructions and use it again when in the landmark's vicinity to get…
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Treasure Map - Scepter of Storms
items.Description:
Somewhere within the Temple of Umberlee hides the coveted Scepter of Storms. Luckily, you have the map!

To follow a treasure map, go to the area it depicts and use it to get your bearings. Follow the map's instructions and use it again when in the landmark's vicinity to get you…
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: NPC: Bloodsailor Uniform
items.Description: This is the somewhat garish uniform of the Bloodsailors pirate guild. By wearing this, a person might be able to fool a casual observer into thinking they are a Bloodsailor. Other actual members would probably see through the deception, however, as such groups are usually very a…

items.Name: Garm's Scale
items.Description: Garm has cobbled this partial suit of scale mail together from scavenged parts.

items.Name: NPC: Pirate Clothes (Brown w Hook & Pegleg)
Poly's Ill-Fated Craft Project
items.Description: You've got to give it 'A' for effort but Poly's artwork clearly suffers from a lack of opposable thumbs...

items.Name: DM Wand - Pirates of the Sword Coast
items.Description:
This wand is for DMs only and is intended for use in the 'Pirates of the Sword Coast' premium module. It allows the user to:

  - Toggle NPC conversation on and off.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Poly's Precious Droppings
items.Description: Thanks, Poly... Thanks...
PropertiesDecoded: Acid Splash (1) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day
Infestation of Maggots (5) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Poly's Mangy Feathers
items.Description: You're not entirely sure why Poly gave you a pair of the few feathers she still has left. You hope it's not like giving someone a lock of your hair because that would be... awkward.
PropertiesDecoded: Charm Person or Animal (3) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Poly's Crystal Egg
items.Description: You've been confused about Poly's gender for quite some time. If this is actually 'hers,' then you suppose that should settle the matter. Even so...
PropertiesDecoded: Aura Of Glory (7) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Poly's Golden Egg
items.Description: You've been confused about Poly's gender for quite some time. If this is actually 'hers,' then you suppose that should settle the matter. Even so...

items.Name: Poly's Parrot Tongue
items.Description: You don't think this tongue is actually Poly's. A part of you wishes it was, mind you...

items.Name: King Utnal's Morningstar
items.Description: You took this morningstar from the corpse of Utnal, King of Troglodyte Island.
PropertiesDecoded: Reptilian Attack Bonus vs. Racial Group +2

items.Name: Potion of Inflict Critical Wounds
items.Description: This bottle is filled with a vile, ichor-like substance. You hope no one expects you to actually drink it.
PropertiesDecoded: Inflict Critical Wounds (12) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Inflict Light Wounds
items.Description: This bottle is filled with a vile, ichor-like substance. You hope no one expects you to actually drink it.
PropertiesDecoded: Inflict Light Wounds (5) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Inflict Moderate Wounds
items.Description: This bottle is filled with a vile, ichor-like substance. You hope no one expects you to actually drink it.
PropertiesDecoded: Inflict Moderate Wounds (7) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Inflict Minor Wounds
items.Description: This bottle is filled with a vile, ichor-like substance. You hope no one expects you to actually drink it.
PropertiesDecoded: Inflict Minor Wounds (1) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Potion of Inflict Serious Wounds
items.Description: This bottle is filled with a vile, ichor-like substance. You hope no one expects you to actually drink it.
PropertiesDecoded: Inflict Serious Wounds (9) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Uniform of the Midnight Rose
items.Description: Your buttons gleam and the wind tugs at the dyed cotton. This uniform bears the rank and insignia of Ship's Sailor. While it's a lowly rank aboard the Midnight Rose, it's nevertheless highly regarded when in port.

items.Name: NPC: Rusty Al's Garb
items.Description: Crusted with rust and blood, this tattooist's garb seems... unhygenic...

items.Name: Wooden Eye
items.Description: Something about this wooden eye is creeping you out. You wonder how many pirates it's belonged to...

items.Name: Fish Gizzard
items.Description: That's odd... You didn't think fish had gizzards...

items.Name: Whale's Ear
items.Description: It seems rather small for a whale's ear. Perhaps you shouldn't have gotten your hopes up...

items.Name: Dead Roach
items.Description: This is a dead cockroach... At least you *think* it's dead...

items.Name: Lucky Squid Tentacle
items.Description: You admit that you've never really thought of squid tentacles as being particularly lucky before...

items.Name: Playing Cards
items.Description: A deck of playing cards to pass the time at sea.

items.Name: Sailor's Kite
items.Description: A kite to fly behind your ship and pass the time at sea.

items.Name: Lock of Hair
items.Description: A lock of hair, often given to sailors by their lovers to serve as a memento while at sea.

items.Name: Driftglass
items.Description: Worn smooth by sea and sand, this piece of broken glass catches the light in such a remarkable way...
PropertiesDecoded: Color Spray (2) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Kazoo
items.Description: Kazoos provide great entertainment to those who play them. Those forced to listen often take a dimmer view of things.
PropertiesDecoded: Sound Burst (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Blueglass Bauble
items.Description: A piece of colored glass cut to look like a proper gem. You suppose it could fool some people...

items.Name: Greenglass Bauble
items.Description: A piece of colored glass cut to look like a proper gem. You suppose it could fool some people...

items.Name: Deathly Poison
items.Description: You're not sure exactly what type of poison this might be but, judging by the skull on the stopper and the little warning label that reads "DANGER: Poison," you assume it must do something nasty...

items.Name: Bocce Ball
items.Description: A round ball used in the popular tossing game of bocce. You wonder if you could get someone to install a bocce pit on your next ship...

items.Name: Sailcloth Patch
items.Description: A patch of sturdy sailcloth, often used by sailors to repair holes in the knees or the seat of their pants.

items.Name: Golden Whatsit
items.Description: You're not exactly sure what this is but the gold ought to be worth something, at least.

items.Name: Stowaway
items.Description: You found a stowaway! Unfortunately, it doesn't look like this one survived the crossing...
PropertiesDecoded: Ray of Enfeeblement (2) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Sailor's Harp
items.Description: This ill-made harp is warped and out of tune. You're almost afraid to play it as you suspect the merest note might cause the flimsy old thing to collapse into dust.
PropertiesDecoded: Deafening Clang (6) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Troglodyte Mask
items.Description: A troglodyte mask, perfect for playing pranks on your bunkmates in the middle of the night.

items.Name: Breadfruit
items.Description: The strangely doughy fruit of the so-called breadplant is bland and tasteless but surprisingly nourishing.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Prize Haddock
items.Description: This haddock has been stuffed and mounted. Whoever caught it must have been very proud of the accomplishment.

items.Name: Prize Rock Cod
items.Description: This rock cod has been stuffed and mounted. Whoever caught it must have been very proud of the accomplishment.

items.Name: Prize Alewife
items.Description: This alewife has been stuffed and mounted. Whoever caught it must have been very proud of the accomplishment.

items.Name: Prize Herring
items.Description: This herring has been stuffed and mounted. Whoever caught it must have been very proud of the accomplishment.

items.Name: Signal Mirror
items.Description: By reflecting the light of the sun, this signal mirror allows ships to communicate over quite a distance.

items.Name: Suction Goblet
items.Description: A recent innovation, these goblets have proven quite popular among pirates and honest sailors alike. A suction cup at the goblet's base ensures that it doesn't tip in even the roughest seas.

items.Name: Devil's Mask
items.Description: A devil mask, perfect for playing pranks on your bunkmates in the middle of the night.

items.Name: Navigational Charts - Moonshae Isles
items.Description: Navigational charts are becoming increasingly popular on modern ships. Previously everyone sailed willy-nilly with no clear idea of where they were or where they were headed.

items.Name: Navigational Charts - Sea of Fallen Stars
items.Description: Navigational charts are becoming increasingly popular on modern ships. Previously everyone sailed willy-nilly with no clear idea of where they were or where they were headed.

items.Name: Letter of Marque
items.Description: Obtaining a Letter of Marque from the local government grants you immunity from prosecution for raiding enemy ships. As such, it is an important rite of passage for those hoping to become a noble Privateer and ultimately a respected Pirate King. This one has a blank line where y…

items.Name: Message in a Bottle
items.Description: You found a message in a bottle! How exciting! Unfortunately it's in a foreign language that you can't seem to make heads or tails of. Darn ocean currents...

items.Name: Magic Potatoes
items.Description: You inspect the potatoes carefully but can't seem to find anything particularly magical about them.

items.Name: Dragonfruit
items.Description: Known for their scaly peel and bittersweet taste, dragonfruit are appreciated more for their novelty than their nourishment.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Light Wounds (5) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Half-Eaten Book
items.Description: If you were marooned on a desert island, what is the one book you'd take with you?

items.Name: Electric Blanket
items.Description: Electric blankets are popular items aboard ships heading for colder climes. Judging by the frayed cord and exposed wires, this one has seen better days...

items.Name: Abandoned Astrolabe
items.Description: For thousands of years, sailors have relied on the astrolabe to help them navigate the seas with the aid of the night stars. Now everyone uses the sextant because it has a cooler name.

items.Name: Hempen Rope
items.Description: Stronger and less prone to rot than softer cotton, hempen ropes are commonly used to hoist the rigging and secure the ship.

items.Name: Maztican Silver
items.Description: Tragically, much of the finest art of the Maztican Empire has been melted down into bars and ingots to better fill the holds of its Amnish conquerors.

items.Name: Glossed Tin Mirror
items.Description: Notoriously prone to breakage, large glass mirrors rarely survive for any length at sea. Some luxury ships have tried to remedy the situation by supplying their wealthy passengers with mirrors fashioned from a polished, reflective tin.

items.Name: Small Firekeg
items.Description: Small enough to fit in the hand yet explosive enough to sow the seeds of chaos, small firekegs such as these are popular among buccaneers and raiders.

items.Name: Hoard of Jewels
items.Description: Some pirates consider it a mark of pride to pay their way in jewels rather than in proper coin. "Mint me a coin with no king or ruler on the back o' it," the Dread Pirate Kraggus is reported to have said, "and I'll gladly make it mine."

items.Name: X-treme Bocce Ball
items.Description: A round ball used in the popular tossing game of bocce. This ball is intended for the more X-treme version of the sport where physical contact and dismemberment is actively encouraged. You wonder if you could get someone to install a bocce pit on your next ship...
PropertiesDecoded: Gedlee's Electric Loop (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Deck Swab
items.Description: What seafarers insist on referring to as a 'deck swab' is actually just a normal wetmop.

items.Name: Driftwood
items.Description: You've never understood why people insist on collecting things like driftwood and rocks and seashells. What's so bloody special about them anyway?

items.Name: Crossbones
items.Description: There's something very piratey about crossbones but you can't quite put your finger on what it is.

items.Name: Skull
items.Description: There's something very piratey about skulls but you can't quite put your finger on what it is.

items.Name: Cured Sausage
items.Description: Mmmm. Cured sausage never goes bad... Well almost never...
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Self Only Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Message Bottle
items.Description: Someone's already removed the message from this bottle. You wonder if you could fit a ship in it somehow...

items.Name: Suction Goblet
items.Description: A recent innovation, these goblets have proven quite popular among pirates and honest sailors alike. A suction cup at the goblet's base ensures that it doesn't tip in even the roughest seas.

items.Name: Wooden Suction Goblet
items.Description: A recent innovation, these goblets have proven quite popular among pirates and honest sailors alike. A suction cup at the goblet's base ensures that it doesn't tip in even the roughest seas. Something about this wooden version smacks of a cheap ripoff, however.

items.Name: Pixie in a Bottle
items.Description: How did that pixie get in there, anyways? Dang pixies...

items.Name: Cod Tongue
items.Description: Cod tongue is often considered a delicacy by those who haven't already tried it...

items.Name: Deck Darts
items.Description: Like their landlubber cousins, lawn darts, deck darts are rubber-tipped for safety. More fun than cards or bocce, many sailors consider a good game of deck darts as a perfectly acceptable way to pass the time while at sea.

items.Name: Sailor's Flask
items.Description: It's a nice enough flask but far too empty for your tastes...

items.Name: Fine Silverware
items.Description: You wonder where these were looted and pillaged from...

items.Name: Fish Knife
items.Description: Too weak to serve as a dagger, this knife's broadly serrated edge and thin profile make it ideal for gutting fish.

items.Name: Line Winch
items.Description: Line winches are often used to tighten the rigging or secure the ropes in the cargo hold.

items.Name: Stinky Fish Bones
items.Description: You're not entirely sure why you haven't thrown this away yet. If you leave it long enough, maybe someone else will do it.

items.Name: Broken Glass
items.Description: These sharp and shattered fragments are likely all that remain of a once-fine bottle of rum.

items.Name: Maztican Statuette
items.Description: Something about this silver statuette unnerves you. Most Maztican jewelry and art was melted down into ingots by their Amnish conquerors.

items.Name: Pirate Coin
items.Description: Pirates have long considered it a mark of pride to pay their way in jewels rather than in proper coin. "Mint me a coin with no king or ruler on the back o' it," the Dread Pirate Kraggus is reported to have said, "and I'll gladly make it mine." When none would accept his challeng…

items.Name: Maztican Necklace
items.Description: This silver necklace is sadly striking. Most Maztican jewelry and art was melted down into ingots by their Amnish conquerors.

items.Name: Pirate Coin Amulet
items.Description: Pirates have long considered it a mark of pride to pay their way in jewels rather than in proper coin. "Mint me a coin with no king or ruler on the back o' it," the Dread Pirate Kraggus is reported to have said, "and I'll gladly make it mine." When none would accept his challeng…

items.Name: Boarding Arrows
items.Description:
Having seen far too many clumsy buccaneers become entangled in the rigging while leaping onto enemy ships, the half-elven pirate, Darius Gulch, spent the bulk of his fortune on the development of teleportation-enabled 'boarding arrows.'

Sadly, loss of life seems just as prevale…
PropertiesDecoded: Daze On Hit Cast Spell Level 3
Teleport Projectile Properties On Hit Cast Spell Level 1

items.Name: Silken Sash
items.Description: There's something about a silken sash about the waist that makes you look like you know what you're talking about.

items.Name: Sail Burners
items.Description: Requiring little skill to fire and doing great damage to ship and sail alike, so-called 'Sail Burner' bolts are a popular starting point for those with piratical intent.

items.Name: Arrr, Yarrr, and Garrr
items.Description:
"Arrr, Yarrr, and Garrr: A Guide to the Pirate Idiom"

This handy reference book for new pirates is already in its third printing.

items.Name: Mothers, Don't Let Your Sons...
items.Description:
"Mothers, Don't Let Your Sons Grow Up to be Pirates"

In recent years, so-called 'pirate poetry' has grown from a literary oddity to a full-fledged genre. Its proponents call the writing timeless but, secretly, you wonder if it's just a fad.

items.Name: S is for Scurvy: A Pirate Potboiler
items.Description: You keep meaning to read this series of mystery novels but the thought of having to start all the way back at "A is for Anchors" rather shivers your timbers...

items.Name: Off the Map!
items.Description:
"Off the Map: A Pirate's Guide to Stand-up Comedy"

Not as funny as the back cover led you to believe...

items.Name: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea
items.Description: Jules Verne? Never heard of him...

items.Name: Swashbuckler's Boots
items.Description: The life of a swashbuckler is full of bravery, grand adventure, and epic fencing duels. Aside from being remarkably comfortable, these swashbuckling boots allow you to dodge your opponent's strikes with greater flair.

items.Name: Shipwright's Gloves
items.Description: This well-used pair of rawhide gloves offer great protection for your hands at the expense of dexterity.
PropertiesDecoded: Bludgeoning AC Bonus vs. Damage Type +1

items.Name: Ensign's Tunic
items.Description: In military terms, the ensign is the lowest rank of commisioned officiers. On pirate vessels, ensigns are the first ones off the boat when you land at the mysterious island, and the ones asked to open the treasure chest in case of traps.

items.Name: Sea Urchin Poison
items.Description: The sea urchin is a small, spine-covered creature found on the seafloor. The roe of the urchin is a popular food. The spines produce a mild poison which will injure but not kill a foe.
PropertiesDecoded: Poison Weapon Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Blowfish Venom
items.Description: Blowfish venom is highly toxic, resulting in nausea and breathing problems. Death can occur within minutes. If poisoned, apply a vinegar-based anti-vemon and seek medical attention.
PropertiesDecoded: Poison Weapon Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Stingray Poison
items.Description: Poisoning from a stingray attack is very serious and must be treated immediately. It usually takes 24-48 hours for an individual to recover completely.
PropertiesDecoded: Poison Weapon Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Ceramic Bowl
items.Description: This simple ceramic bowl could have come from any home along the Sword Coast. It definitely shows signs of looting and pillaging...

items.Name: Expensive Clock
items.Description: This finely crafted clock bears the mark of one of Waterdeep's most skilled clocksmiths. It also shows clear signs of looting and pillaging...

items.Name: Pottery Shards
items.Description: You've heard street hawkers claim that shards such as these were discovered during an excavation of one of the lost cities of Faerun. Over the years, you've stayed at a number of inns that had bowls and cups with the same pattern.

items.Name: Elixir of Cure Critical Seasickness
items.Description: Even the most experienced sailor will experience seasickness now and then. A good ship's chaplain should always have an adequate supply of curative potions on hand.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Critical Wounds (7) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Elixir of Cure Moderate Seasickness
items.Description: Even the most experienced sailor will experience seasickness now and then. A good ship's chaplain should always have an adequate supply of curative potions on hand.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Moderate Wounds (3) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Elixir of Cure Serious Seasickness
items.Description: Even the most experienced sailor will experience seasickness now and then. A good ship's chaplain should always have an adequate supply of curative potions on hand.
PropertiesDecoded: Cure Serious Wounds (5) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Aquatic Bolts
items.Description: These bolts look like they have been specifically designed to be fired while underwater.
PropertiesDecoded: Reptilian Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1d6 Damage

items.Name: Coral Bullets
items.Description: These coral nodules have been shaped into near-perfect spheres. They emit a high-pitched sound, like a boatswain's whistle, as they fly towards their target.

items.Name: Juggling Axes of the 12 Short Adventurers
items.Description: The Twelve Short Adventurers were a popular seafaring circus that traveled the length and breadth of the Nelanthar Isles. The company, comprised of halfling acrobats and escape artists, gained fame and renown for their lavish and imaginative performances.

items.Name: Wrist Splint
items.Description: Carpal tunnel syndrome is a common complaint among sailors forced to wind the rigging day and night.

items.Name: Salt-Crusted Sailor's Cloak
items.Description: A warm cloak can mean the difference between life and death while at sea.

items.Name: Oilskin Bag
items.Description: Sealing your belongings within this bag should keep them from getting too wet.

items.Name: Rusty Pirate's Dagger
items.Description: When clenching this blade between your teeth, be careful not to slice your tongue.

items.Name: Burning Oil
items.Description: Naval battles are a fearful prospect at the best of times but, should you ever witness the surface of the sea erupt in flames about you, it's said you'll never catch a wink of sleep again.
PropertiesDecoded: Alchemist's Fire Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Ropecutter
items.Description: Intended for chopping ropes and rigging in times of emergencies, ruthless buccaneers have been known to turn these blades to other uses while in port.

items.Name: Fine Pirate Cutlass
items.Description: This pirate's cutlass is lightweight and finely balanced, a perfect mix for swashbuckling.
PropertiesDecoded: Human Attack Bonus vs. Racial Group +2

items.Name: Heavy Cutlass
items.Description: This heavy cutlass has a considerable heft and weight for its size. It's intended more for clearing the decks than for lengthy swashbuckling duels.

items.Name: Boarding Knife
items.Description: With its short blade and upturned tip, this simple knife is ideal for hostile boarding actions. While its leading edge is deathly sharp, the other has been intentionally dulled so you can carry it between your teeth while you swing with both hands from the rigging.

items.Name: Maztica: Discovery & Conquest
items.Description: Ten years ago, bold mercenaries in the service of Amn dared the Trackless Sea, sailing into the sunset for week after week until they reached an unexplored land -- Maztica. Fighting against the strange warriors of the land, they established a foothold on the western continent. S…

items.Name: On the Worship of Umberlee
items.Description: Umberlee is widely considered a malicious, mean, and evil deity who breaks agreements on a whim and takes great pleasure in watching others die by drowning or in the jaws of sea predators. Often portrayed as vain and desirous of flattery, she's apparently excessively greedy for …

items.Name: The Nelanthar Isles
items.Description: The Nelanthar Isles are a widely scattered chain of nearly a thousand islands sprinkled from Amn into the Trackless Sea. More than half the islands lack water and are fit only for wrecking ships upon. The hundreds of islands that have drinkable water and can support life are wid…

items.Name: Krakenhelm
items.Description:
These helmets are named for the behemoth of the seas, the kraken. Krakens resemble immense squids but they have eight tentacles and can grow to a length of 90 feet.

Merchants assure queasy customers that the helmet isn't actually made from kraken flesh but owners often swear th…

items.Name: Fancy Pirate Leathers
items.Description: There's nothing particularly special about these pirate leathers but they sure look dashing.

items.Name: Maritime Tales of Faerun
items.Description:
This book is a collection of maritime tales and seafaring ballads from across Faerun. One particular story catches your eye.

Ghost Ships:

The Sword Coast is famed for brutal battles between rival navies, pirates and merchants, sailors and the monsters of the deeps seeking to d…

items.Name: Folklore of Faerun
items.Description:
This book is a collection of tales and traditional ballads from across Faerun.   One particular story catches you eye.

Sariah and the Ocean Strider:

Once upon a time, Sariah Badgeriver met an Ocean Strider. Sariah was fishing, as she did most every day, when she was set upon b…

items.Name: Valkur's Text for Better Living, v.1
items.Description: The Order of the Calming Wave is a monastic order devoted to following the principles established by Valkur, God of Sails. The monks of this order are explorers, adventurers and sailors. This is one of the many proselytizing texts written by the Order and used to illustrate thei…

items.Name: Valkur's Text for Better Living, v.2
items.Description: The Order of the Calming Wave is a monastic order devoted to following the principles established by Valkur, God of Sails. The monks of this order are explorers, adventurers and sailors. This is one of the many proselytizing texts written by the Order and used to illustrate thei…

items.Name: Valkur's Text for Better Living, v.3
items.Description: The Order of the Calming Wave is a monastic order devoted to following the principles established by Valkur, God of Sails. The monks of this order are explorers, adventurers and sailors. This is one of the many proselytizing texts written by the Order and used to illustrate thei…

items.Name: Boots of the Sahuagin
items.Description: The boots were obviously made for surface dwellers and not the sea devils for which they are named. They fit snugly and are made from a water-resistant material, making them popular with sailors and fishermen.

items.Name: Boots of the Calming Wave +1
items.Description: The Order of the Calming Wave was founded by a group of pirates after a particularly fierce storm. The ship's cleric decreed that the Captain had angered Umberlee and brought the storm upon them but Valkur had looked favorably upon them and saw fit to protect them from her wrath…

items.Name: Ring of the Aquatic Elves +1
items.Description:
A piece of coral has been coaxed and smoothed into the shape of a ring.

As aquatic elves wear little clothing or armor, they tend to rely on enchanted jewelry to aid in them in times of peace and war.

items.Name: Sahuagin Spear
items.Description: Waving lines, gleaming pearls, and a three-pronged head mark this strange spear as being of Sahuagin origin.

items.Name: Dread Pirate's Medallion
items.Description: There be two types o' pirates in the world. Noble Privateers grow up to be Pirate Kings while nefarious Buccaneers stake their fame and fortune on becoming Dread Pirates. This medallion be one that once belonged to the latter.
PropertiesDecoded: Lawful AC Bonus vs. Alignment Group +3

items.Name: Swashbuckler's Secret
items.Description: The life of a swashbuckler is full of bravery, grand adventure, and epic fencing duels. Fashioned from light and breathable cotton, this nimble swashbuckling suit gives you a secret edge when fighting with two weapons.

items.Name: Faded Glory
items.Description:
Alexis von Stromme, a disgraced and fallen paladin of Torm, took to the high seas in an effort to hide himself from the accusing eyes of his former god. He never succeeded, of course, and felt ashamed of his misdeeds to the end of his days.

As part of his attempted attonement, …
PropertiesDecoded: Champion of Torm Use Limitation: Class

items.Name: Admiral Olaf's Oilskin
items.Description: Weary of the endless rains that seemed to follow him wherever he went, the famed gnomish navigator, Admiral Olaf Olafson developed a protective rain slicker that was as effective as it was garish. Fashioned from oiled leather and sealed with the waterproof sap of the Chultan rub…
PropertiesDecoded: Flare On Hit Cast Spell Level 5

items.Name: Strength of Will
items.Description: One of the more disciplined pirates to ply the seas, Captain Will Cuthbert maintained a strict daily regimen of proper excercise and a protein-rich diet. His aversion to fruits and vegetables ultimately led to death by scurvy well before the peak of his still nascent career.

items.Name: Tasha's Hideous Getup
items.Description: Scholars remain divided regarding the inner motivations of Dread Pirate Admiral, Tasha MacQueen. Some consider her a trickster and a scallywag of the most nefarious sort while others call her a jokingly innocent naif who simply got caught up in the wrong crowd. All agree that, i…
PropertiesDecoded: Tasha's Hideous Laughter On Hit Cast Spell Level 4

items.Name: Mastfeller
items.Description: Short even by dwarven standards, famed Pirate King Kjell Kristofferson had an almost pathological hatred for tall-masted ships. Whenever he captured one at sea, he would immediately chop down the mainmast and order his tireless crew to row her back to port as if she were a dwarv…

items.Name: Dread Pirate's Bandolier
items.Description: There be two types o' pirates in the world. Noble Privateers grow up to be Pirate Kings while nefarious Buccaneers stake their fame and fortune on becoming Dread Pirates. This bandolier be one that once belonged to the latter.

items.Name: Dread Pirate's Calfskin Boots
items.Description: There be two types o' pirates in the world. Noble Privateers grow up to be Pirate Kings while nefarious Buccaneers stake their fame and fortune on becoming Dread Pirates. These fine calfskin boots be ones that once belonged to the latter.
PropertiesDecoded: Human AC Bonus vs. Racial Group +2

items.Name: Improved Shipwright's Gloves
items.Description: These popular gloves have a leather palm for extra grip and a breathable knit back of Cormyrian cotton for extra comfort.
PropertiesDecoded: Bludgeoning AC Bonus vs. Damage Type +2

items.Name: Master Shipwright's Gloves
items.Description: These gloves are made from fine-grained pigskin. Their unique design exposes the tips of two fingers and the thumb for greater control in even the toughest jobs.
PropertiesDecoded: Bludgeoning AC Bonus vs. Damage Type +3

items.Name: Boatswain's Uniform
items.Description:
The bosun or boatswain acts as a link between the officiers and the crew, by summoning the crew to their duties and  relieving them at watch. The boatswain also ensures that all rigging and cargo are secured.

A boatswain's uniform must provide all the same comfort and protectio…

items.Name: Shipwright's Tunic
items.Description: The shipwright is responsible for ensuring that the hull, masts, yardarms and all other wooden structures aboard the ship are good working order.

items.Name: Armor of the Pirate King
items.Description: Syllialis "Sea Menace" Cladreshe had this suit of armor made to commemorate the day he obtained the title of Pirate King. His fearsome reputation and legendary exploits were enough to inspire his crew but he knew he'd need more than that to protect himself against anyone bold en…

items.Name: Shirt of the Able Seaman
items.Description:
A seaman is responsible for any duties on deck save navigation. The duties are many and varied, ranging from cleaning the deck and the operation and handling of the rigging to manning the lifeboat in times of emergency.

Clothing worn by a seaman must be light and comfortable en…

items.Name: Midshipman's Garb
items.Description:
Happy Jack the pirate began his career at age nine when he was kidnapped by the Dread Pirate Silverfalls and forced to serve as midshipman.
 
A midshipman is the captain's servant while learning the basics of seamanship and navigation.

items.Name: Privateer Sagewell's Figurehead
items.Description: Born into a proud noble family, Talissa Sagewell served as a Purple Dragon Knight of Cormyr until being discharged for a crime she did not commit. Disheartened and bitter, she was eventually drawn into a life of piracy where she allowed the sea to wash away her pain and hostilit…

items.Name: Lockpicker's Ring
items.Description: This ring is made up of tiny prongs, wires, and other small devices that spring to life on command. Pirates are notorious for accidentally locking themselves out of their own treasure chests.

items.Name: Haunting Portrait
items.Description: This portrait of a distinguished gentleman of Luskan stares back at you. His eyes seem to follow you wherever you go, as if blaming you for all the looting and pillaging that brought him here.

items.Name: Harp of the Beastmaster
items.Description: Life at sea is a dangerous prospect at the best of times. The calmest of waters can be home to the foulest of beasts. Even in times of peace, however, it's a useful means of charming your way into the ship's larder.
PropertiesDecoded: Charm Person or Animal (3) Cast Spell 3 Uses/Day

items.Name: The Clanhold Defender
items.Description:
The Pirate King Brohm was a privateer of impeccable honor. He and his crew sailed his longship, the Clanhold, against only the most nefarious of buccaneers and Dread Pirates.

In Brohm's absence, however, orcs descended on the ship's undefended namesake, killing off all of the c…

items.Name: The Dolphin Prince
items.Description:
The dolphin etched into the base of this trident signifies that it once served a cleric of the Elven god, Deep Sashelas.
Elven script winds its way up the stock.

Translated it reads: "Promote knowledge and grant reasonable folk use of the sea. Fight those who would taint its be…
PropertiesDecoded: Monstrous Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1d6 Damage
Reptilian Damage Bonus vs. Racial Type 1d6 Damage

items.Name: The Fleet Admiral's Favorite
items.Description: The sole benefit of being attacked at sea is that it's very hard to be ambushed. Though pirates are certainly feared for their skill with cutlasses and rapiers, the heart of the battle occurs at range. Once they've boarded, you've already lost...

items.Name: Wand of the Winds
items.Description: What sailor hasn't dreamed of mastering the winds? While wands such as these certainly have their use, one would have to fill an entire hold with them if you hoped to sail any distance under their power.
PropertiesDecoded: Gust of Wind (10) Cast Spell 5 Charges/Use

items.Name: Swashbuckler's Cape
items.Description: The life of a swashbuckler is full of bravery, grand adventure, and epic fencing duels. Aside from looking rather dashing, this swashbuckling cape will also protect you from the blades of your nefarious enemies.
PropertiesDecoded: Slashing AC Bonus vs. Damage Type +1

items.Name: Sea's Bounty
items.Description: The sea holds many secrets within her depths and much knowledge long thought lost. It is said that those who wear this helm will gain at least some portion of her ancient wisdom.

items.Name: Seahawk's Helm
items.Description:
The Might Seahawks were a cabal of ill-fated Waterdhavian nobles who led a secret life at sea. Anonymous beneath their hawklike helms, they plundered countless of their city's own treasure galleons in their endless quest for riches.

Fearful of a scandal, the Admiral of the Wate…

items.Name: Sudden Squall
items.Description: Storms at sea are a common occurrence. Some have been known to descend from a clear blue sky before disappearing as suddenly as they arrived.
PropertiesDecoded: Cloud of Bewilderment (3) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day
Ice Storm (9) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Staff of the Ill-Fated Mariner
items.Description: Lightning is a fickle mistress, even moreso when you're at sea. After all, you're surrounded by water and your crowsnest is often the highest point for miles around...
PropertiesDecoded: Ball Lightning (9) Cast Spell Single Use
Call Lightning (5) Cast Spell Single Use
Electric Jolt On Hit Cast Spell Level 1

items.Name: Yardarm
items.Description: Somethings are best dealt with at the end of a ten-foot pole. Barring that, a stout five-foot yardarm should suffice, provided you no longer need it to hold up the sail...
PropertiesDecoded: Ooze Attack Bonus vs. Racial Group +3

items.Name: Ankle Cutter
items.Description: In the chaotic melee of a boarding action, there's nothing some pirates like better than a small hook for sweeping people's feet out from under them.

items.Name: Deckhand's Defence
items.Description: Shields such as this one are often carried by honest deckhands plying their trade in troubled shipping lanes. The first sign of an impending pirate attack is often the sudden volley of arrows from a passing ship.
PropertiesDecoded: Piercing AC Bonus vs. Damage Type +3

items.Name: Windbreaker
items.Description: Visper steps out of her shelter only to be knocked back in by a blast of frigid air. It has been ten days since she and her crew were forced to abandon her ship to the ice-packed seas. Their only hope now rests in being able to trek south across the spine of the world to reach I…

items.Name: Endless Skies
items.Description: The cloud giant Stratadin Icehammer was a blacksmith of great regard. He crafted a suit of armor much like this as a tribute to his god Stronmaus. As trade ties are strong between Stratadin's clan and the coastal settlements of peaceful 'little people' that live in their shadow,…
PropertiesDecoded: Giant AC Bonus vs. Racial Group +2

items.Name: Dragonbreath Arrow
items.Description: A dragonbreath arrow has a shaft soaked in resin or pitch and a slightly enlarged head filled with a vial of alchemist's fire.
PropertiesDecoded: Dark Fire (Immolate) On Hit Cast Spell Level 1

items.Name: Robe of the Calming Wave
items.Description: The Order of the Calming Wave is a monastic order devoted to following the principles established by Valkur, God of Sails. The monks of this order are explorers, adventurers and sailors, infusing their vestments with magic in order to protect themselves from the elements.

items.Name: Swashbuckler's Frock
items.Description:
Salt spray on your face, a blue sky overhead, emerald seas stretching out to the far horizon: these are the objects of your desire.

Life is good and you guzzle from destiny's wineskin with big gulps and a hearty cry of 'Yo-ho-ho!' Your hold is filled with goods and cargo and yo…

items.Name: Stormscale
items.Description: Designed in honor of Umberlee's sahuagin servants, this armor was first worn by the Dread Pirate, Admiral Bluenose. Having already been struck by lightning once for disobeying the goddess' commands, he was doing his best to make amends.
PropertiesDecoded: Electric Jolt On Hit Cast Spell Level 1

items.Name: Bronze Dragon Armor
items.Description: The aquatic lifestyle common to many bronze dragons can make them easy pickings for those pirates daring (or foolish) enough to deal in dragon hides.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 40% of Weight

items.Name: Dragon Turtle Armor
items.Description:
Undrinkable by humans, the warm waters of the Lake of Steam are rich in minerals that cause many species of weeds, shellfish, birds, and turtles, to grow to great size.

Adventurers daring enough to battle these monsters are guaranteed to find a merchant in Calimport willing to …

items.Name: Dread Pirate's Helm
items.Description: Historically, some Dread Pirates prefer anonymity as it allows for a more comfortable retirement. In some cases, multiple pirates have shared the title between themselves with the current Dread Pirate being whoever is wearing the mask.

items.Name: Embezzler's Leathers
items.Description: The outlawed privateer, Swinson Dee, was renowned for his efforts to champion the poor. His band of seafaring raiders would steal from wealthy traders and others passing through his swath of sea, only to turn around and surrender the loot to the peasant fisherman along the nearb…

items.Name: Calishite Chain
items.Description: This armor seems strangely cool to the touch, no matter what the environment. Manufactured in Calimshan, chainmail of this type is greatly prized all along the Shining Sea, particularly in the vicinity of the Calim Desert, where the extreme temperatures otherwise make it quite d…

items.Name: Boots of the Calming Wave +2
items.Description: The Order of the Calming Wave was founded by a group of pirates after a particularly fierce storm. The ship's cleric decreed that the Captain had angered Umberlee and brought the storm upon them but Valkur had looked favorably upon them and saw fit to protect them from her wrath…

items.Description: The Order of the Calming Wave was founded by a group of pirates after a particularly fierce storm. The ship's cleric decreed that the Captain had angered Umberlee and brought the storm upon them but Valkur had looked favorably upon them and saw fit to protect them from her wrath…

items.Name: Sirine's Cloak +1
items.Description: Sirines are playful and gregarious aquatic fey who often draw strangers into their games and parties, only to tire of their companionship after a few hours and slip away. If someone has been particularly charming company, however, the sirine will bestow the gift of a shell or sm…

items.Description: Sirines are playful and gregarious aquatic fey who often draw strangers into their games and parties, only to tire of their companionship after a few hours and slip away. If someone has been particularly charming company, however, the sirine will bestow the gift of a shell or sm…

items.Name: Gloves of the Calming Wave +1

"Give us a song, Angus!"

"Do you know this one, Angus?"

No one ever asked if Angus wanted to sing. Maybe he just wanted to sit quietly in the stern of the ship and drink his rum but no one ever let him. He wrote this little jig for the next damned crewman to ask...
